source_caption_text:
Jaden Smith really knew how to make an entrance with “Icon”

Jaden Smith on “Icon” is probably one of the most memorable ways anyone has introduced themselves to the rap game. Released in 2017, the song immediately made it clear that Jaden wasn’t trying to follow the usual blueprint. From the bold delivery to the “icon living” hook, the whole track feels like someone introducing the world to exactly who they believe they are.

The production gives him plenty of room to make that statement, with the hard-hitting drums, distorted guitar, and background vocals creating a sound that still feels unique. Jaden spends the song talking about his style, MSFTSrep, success, and doing things his own way. There’s a confidence to the record that makes it easy to understand why the song caught on so quickly.

Then there’s the video, which became just as recognizable as the song itself. The gold grills, oversized chain, denim, sports car, and sunset shots gave “Icon” an instantly memorable look, while Will Smith’s parody later made the whole moment even bigger. Jaden really made an introduction that people couldn’t ignore, and years later, “Icon” still feels like one of his defining moments.
